monitoringCommands.title: Detect **suspect setup actions** in major org
monitoringCommands.description: Inspects the Setup Audit Trail and flags configuration changes that fall outside the allow list, helping spot risky or unexpected admin activity.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect calls to **deprecated API versions**
monitoringCommands.description: Lists API clients calling Salesforce on deprecated API versions so they can be migrated before Salesforce retires them.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect if **org limits** are close to be reached
monitoringCommands.description: Checks Salesforce org limits (storage, API requests, async jobs, etc.) and warns when usage gets close to the cap.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **Apex flex queue backlog**
monitoringCommands.description: Monitors the AsyncApexJob Holding queue and alerts when the number of pending batch jobs crosses a threshold.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **Apex and Flow errors**
monitoringCommands.description: Aggregates recent Apex exceptions and Flow run failures from the org and reports the count and most recent occurrences.

monitoringCommands.title: Agent tests
monitoringCommands.description: Run all Agentforce agent tests (AiEvaluationDefinition) in the org and report pass / fail results for each test case.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **unsecured Connected Apps** in an org
monitoringCommands.description: Lists Connected Apps whose OAuth policies do not require explicit user approval, surfacing potential SSO and authorization risks.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **MFA configuration gaps** in the org
monitoringCommands.description: Audits org-wide MFA enforcement, MFA-bypass permission usage, privileged user coverage, SSO presence, and recent non-MFA direct UI logins.

monitoringCommands.title: Audit **dangerous permissions** granted through Profiles and Permission Sets
monitoringCommands.description: Lists dangerous permissions (Modify All Data, Author Apex, Manage Users, View All Data...) granted through Profiles, Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups, and which active users hold them.

monitoringCommands.title: Analyze **metadata deployments and validations**
monitoringCommands.description: Summarizes metadata deployments and validations performed against the org during the configured period, with success / failure counts.

monitoringCommands.title: Extract **licenses** information
monitoringCommands.description: Reports the current allocation, used count, and remaining seats for every license type in the org.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **custom elements with no access rights** defined in permission sets
monitoringCommands.description: Finds custom fields, objects, Apex classes and other elements that have no access defined in any Profile or Permission Set.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **permission set licenses** that are assigned to users that do not need them
monitoringCommands.description: Identifies Permission Set Licenses assigned to users who do not actually use any of the features they grant, so seats can be reclaimed.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **active users without recent logins** (All licenses, 6 months)
monitoringCommands.description: Lists active users (all licenses) who have not logged in for at least 6 months, surfacing candidates for deactivation.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **active users without recent logins** (CRM, 6 months)
monitoringCommands.description: Lists active users holding a CRM license who have not logged in for at least 6 months.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **active users without recent logins** (Experience, 6 months)
monitoringCommands.description: Lists active Experience Cloud users who have not logged in for at least 6 months.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **active users with recent logins** (CRM, 1 week)
monitoringCommands.description: Reports the count of CRM users who logged in over the past week, a useful indicator for adoption metrics.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **active users with recent logins** (Experience, 1 month)
monitoringCommands.description: Reports the count of Experience Cloud users who logged in over the past month.

monitoringCommands.title: Gather warnings about **incoming and overdue Release Updates**
monitoringCommands.description: Surfaces Salesforce Release Updates that are due soon or overdue, with the actions required to comply.

monitoringCommands.title: Get **org info** + SF instance info + next major upgrade date
monitoringCommands.description: Captures the org edition, instance name, API version and the date of the next scheduled Salesforce upgrade.

monitoringCommands.title: Run **Salesforce Security Health Check**
monitoringCommands.description: Runs the Salesforce Security Health Check and reports the score plus the most severe findings.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **custom labels and custom permissions** that are not in use
monitoringCommands.description: Finds Custom Labels and Custom Permissions that are not referenced anywhere in the metadata, so they can be safely removed.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **unused Apex classes** in an org
monitoringCommands.description: Identifies Apex classes that are not invoked from any trigger, controller, Flow, Process Builder, or scheduled job.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **Apex classes and triggers with deprecated API version**
monitoringCommands.description: Lists Apex classes and triggers whose API version is below the supported floor and should be upgraded.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **unused Connected Apps** in an org
monitoringCommands.description: Lists Connected Apps that have not been used recently, surfacing candidates for cleanup.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **inactive metadata**
monitoringCommands.description: Reports metadata components (Flows, Validation Rules, etc.) that are inactive in the org and may be safe to remove.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **missing description** on custom field
monitoringCommands.description: Finds custom fields that are missing a description, helping enforce documentation standards across the project.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **underused permission sets**
monitoringCommands.description: Identifies Permission Sets assigned to a small number of users, often a sign they can be merged or retired.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **permission sets with minimal permissions** in project
monitoringCommands.description: Finds Permission Sets that grant almost no permissions and are likely placeholders or leftover artifacts.

monitoringCommands.title: Detect **usage-based entitlements** consumed faster than their period allows
monitoringCommands.description: Reads contractual consumption meters and projects end-of-period usage, so overages surface before the invoice.

monitoringCommands.title: Report active **utilization alerts** raised by Salesforce
monitoringCommands.description: Lists consumption and license utilization alerts Salesforce raised on the org.

monitoringCommands.title: Track **Agentforce and Data 360 credit** consumption
monitoringCommands.description: Breaks down generative AI and Data 360 credit usage by agent and action. Needs Data 360.
